title: The Mycelial Synapse
subtitle: The heart-node's stake
text: In the Gardens an Apotheos sets a Sporite Crystal against a hematic iron block on any face, holds a Sanguine Formation in the offhand and pours 120 mL into the iron. The synapse must chain to the heart-node or another of your synapses and touch no one else's envelope, and a node holds six. Each one widens the envelope in which its owner heals and gathers spores.
